caption: The drawing depicts a musical instrument that combines the features of a harp and a piano. The lower section is a piano with a wooden rectangular body, white and black keys, and ornate decorative elements in gold and blue on its front legs. The piano supports an upright harp structure at its back, with a large, gold-colored column on the left and a curving gold and grey frame with numerous harp strings extending vertically. Decorative gold motifs are also present along the harp’s frame, and a small, gold urn-like object sits on the right rear corner above the piano. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige color with no other objects or patterns present.
title: Upright Harp/Piano
